titulo: Quiz — Arerugii ga arimasu — the sentence you say before anything else
subtitulo: The hammer sentence, then nuki de plus the thing
introPt: A traveller says the allergy sentence before the order is written, and the question goes to the kitchen.
cenario: A neighbourhood restaurant, early evening, menus not yet handed out.

dialogo.es: ピーナッツアレルギーがあります。命に関わります。
dialogo.pt: I have a peanut allergy. It is life-threatening.
dialogo.tts: ピーナッツアレルギーがあります。命に関わります。

dialogo.es: 厨房で確認してきます。それまで注文しないでください。
dialogo.pt: I'll go and check in the kitchen. Please don't order anything before that.
dialogo.tts: 厨房で確認してきます。それまで注文しないでください。

dialogo.es: ピーナッツ抜きで、とても大切です。
dialogo.tts: ピーナッツ抜きで、とても大切です。

dialogo.es: 料理長が確認しました。こちらは大丈夫です。
dialogo.pt: The chef checked. This one, you can have.
dialogo.tts: 料理長が確認しました。こちらは大丈夫です。

perguntas.pergunta: Why is inochi ni kakawarimasu attached to the allergy sentence?
opcoes: It is the polite ending Japanese sentences need
It is what separates a medical allergy from a preference
It means the dish is expensive
perguntas.explica: The second half is what sends somebody to the kitchen rather than nodding at the table.

perguntas.pergunta: The waiter turns and walks towards the kitchen without answering. What is happening?
opcoes: He is fetching the answer from the person who cooked it
He is finding somebody who speaks English
perguntas.explica: The pass holds the list. Walking away is the answer arriving, not the answer being dodged.

perguntas.pergunta: How do you turn nyuuseihin nuki de into an opening rather than a demand?
perguntas.explica: Nyuuseihin nuki wa dekimasu ka lets the kitchen tell you what does work.

perguntas.pergunta: When do you hand over the written allergy card?
opcoes: Instead of speaking, to avoid mispronouncing it
After you have said the sentence out loud
Only at the till when paying
Never — the card replaces the sentence
perguntas.explica: Sentence first, card second. The card is the second copy, not the opening move.

perguntas.pergunta: Which number do you ask somebody to call for an ambulance?
perguntas.explica: 119 reaches fire and ambulance, 110 the police. There is no single 112 line as in Europe.
